```sql
SELECT CAST(COUNT(r.id) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid)
FROM rulings r
JOIN cards c ON r.uuid = c.uuid
JOIN sets s ON c."setCode" = s.code
WHERE r.date >= '2017-02-01'
  AND r.date < '2017-03-01'
  AND s."releaseDate" >= '2017-02-01'
  AND s."releaseDate" < '2017-03-01';
```
